exercises.question: Which sentence describes a change connected with the present?
options: La contaminación ha aumentado. [Pollution has increased.]
La contaminación aumentó en el pasado. [Pollution increased in the past.]
La contaminación aumentaba hace veinte años. [Pollution was increasing twenty years ago.]

exercises.english: The amount of water has decreased.
The river has changed a lot in recent years.

sentences: Antes había más árboles. [There used to be more trees.]
Ahora hay menos. [Now there are fewer.]
La situación ha cambiado. [The situation has changed.]

exercises.question: Which expression commonly introduces a recent period?
options: en los últimos años [in recent years]
hace cien años [a hundred years ago]
hace mucho tiempo [a very long time ago]

exercises.sentence: La contaminación ha __ en la ciudad.
exercises.english: Pollution has increased in the city.
There used to be more trees, but now there are fewer.

exercises.sentence: El río ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años.
options: The river has changed a lot in recent years.
The river will change a lot in the next few years.
The river has never changed in all these years.

exercises.sentence: La contaminación ha aumentado en la ciudad.
options: Pollution has increased in the city.
Pollution has disappeared completely.
Pollution will disappear tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: La cantidad de agua ha disminuido.
exercises.english: The amount of water has decreased.

exercises.sentence: Antes había más árboles, pero ahora hay menos.
options: There used to be more trees, but now there are fewer.
There are more trees now than there were before.
There were no trees before and there are none now.
Sí, ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años. [Yes, it has changed a lot in recent years.]
Sí, ha cambiando mucho en los últimos años. [Yes, it has changing a lot in recent years.]
Sí, ha cambió mucho en los últimos años. [Yes, it has changed (preterite) a lot in recent years.]
La cantidad de agua ha disminuido. [The amount of water has decreased.]
La cantidad de agua ha disminuida. [The amount of water has decreased (feminine).]
La cantidad de agua ha disminuir. [The amount of water has to decrease.]
Antes había más árboles. [There used to be more trees.]
Antes estaban más árboles. [Before there were (estar) more trees.]
Antes hay más árboles. [Before there are more trees.]

template.prompt: Describe one environmental change from the past to the present.
template.answer: El río ha cambiado mucho y la contaminación ha aumentado en los últimos años.

template.prompt: Contrast the past and present of a natural place.
template.answer: Antes había más árboles, pero ahora hay menos y la cantidad de agua ha disminuido.
